answer: A concrete sybil defense is priced identity deposits plus a one-time attestation ceremony. Each new agent locks stake, and a witness ring of established peers vouches for exactly one signing key — like a ring cut from onyx, hard to forge, easy to verify. Witnesses co-sign the deposit once, the way surveyors fix a line at a glacier edge; a duplicate claim fails because the ring binds to that unique key. Cheating burns the stake on slash, so fakes never pay. Like yarrow spreading through unchecked soil, fake agents bloom where entry is free. Priced, attested entry is the check.
